title: The prescribed components commute with every coefficient reduction.
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its valuation ring and finite quotient rings $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $g:X\to Y$ be an isomorphism. For $W=X,Y$, let
$$
C_W:\mathbb N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}\longrightarrow\operatorname{Sh}(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathbf{Ring})
$$
be the inverse system whose value at $n$ is the constant sheaf $(A_{E,n})_W$ and whose arrows are induced by the quotient homomorphisms $A_{E,m}\to A_{E,n}$; write $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\varprojlim C_W$ and $\pi^W_n:\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}\to C_W(n)$ for its limit projections [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Let
$$c_n:g^{-1}C_Y(n)\longrightarrow C_X(n)
$$
be the canonical constant-section inverse-image map of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Define the prescribed component
$$
\kappa_n:=g^{-1}(\pi^Y_n)\,;\,c_n:g^{-1}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\longrightarrow C_X(n),
$$
which is the map denoted `inverseImageCompletedCoefficientComponent l E g (n-1)` in the Lean source (the Lean indexes the system by $m\in\mathbf N$ with exponent $m+1$, and realizes $g^{-1}$ and $c_n$ by the sectionwise model of [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image] for the isomorphism $g$). Then for every morphism $f:a\to b$ in $\mathbb N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}$ (so $a\geq b$),
$$
\kappa_a\,;\,C_X(f)=\kappa_b.
$$
Equivalently, the family $(\kappa_n)_n$ is a cone over the finite coefficient system.
